props.name: past
props.description: Steps already applied, oldest first. The last one is what undo reverses.

props.name: future
props.description: Steps undone, most recently undone first.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Reverse `steps` entries from the end of `past`.

props.name: onRedo
props.description: Reapply `steps` entries from the front of `future`.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Bind the platform undo and redo shortcuts while this is mounted.

props.name: historyLimit
props.description: Entries offered in the history list.
